title: EDI and B2B Document Exchange Competitive Landscape

scope.description: Providers competing with Transus for EDI network, web EDI and e-invoicing subscriptions of retail suppliers, retailers and wholesalers in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: EDI service providers and networks with a sales presence in Transus' markets (including European retail EDI specialists such as Comarch and EDITEL), and e-invoicing/Peppol providers that compete for the same mandate-driven demand (including e-invoicing networks such as Tradeshift, which absorbed the Belgian cloud EDI provider Babelway). Excluded: ERP vendors' own EDI modules, generic iPaaS tools, and Transus' certified partners (Tickstar, Ecobit, NAS conception) and Katapull siblings.
scope.notes: Only figures found on official pages are recorded, with their reported scope; most private competitors publish no comparable figures. Transus itself states 100,000+ connected trading partners in 40+ countries, which is a network count, not a customer count.

players.name: SPS Commerce
players.description: Large retail EDI network provider (Fulfillment, analytics, e-invoicing). Acquired the Dutch EDI and e-invoicing provider TIE Kinetix (Breukelen) in 2023, giving it a direct presence in Transus' Benelux and German markets; tiekinetix.com now redirects to SPS Commerce Europe.

players.name: ecosio
players.description: Cloud EDI as a managed service with Peppol connectivity and SAP integration, strong in German-speaking Europe (customers include Coop Switzerland); a direct alternative for Transus' German and Benelux customers. Part of Vertex Inc. since 2024.

businessStats.value: USD 69m (about 5x ecosio revenue run rate; plus targeted earn-out of USD 76m cash and USD 35m in Vertex shares)
